title: Maz Kanata
subtitle: The Resistance
description: More than a thousand years old, Maz Kanata had seen many things, and had even claimed to see the same eyes appear over and over again in different people. Peculiar, but tuned into the facets of the Force, Maz ran her castle on Takodana with an air of neutrality until the First Order transformed it into rubble in one sweeping attack.
